newsitem.title: UK: London gold closes $1 firmer, holding above $380.
newsitem.headline: London gold closes $1 firmer, holding above $380.

text.p: GOLD - Closes firmer at $380.90/$381.40 vs $379.90/$380.40 on Thursday. Holding above key $380 level so far, but seen vulnerable to downside pressure. Breach targets $375. SILVER - Ends up four cents at $4.92/$4.94. PLATINUM - Finishes down 25 cents at $384.75/$385.75. PALLADIUM - Ends up 75 cents at $118.00/$119.00.
